english.title: Act as a hackney carriage driver without a licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) acted as the driver of a hackney carriage, namely **(..SPECIFY HACKNEY CARRIAGE..), at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) without having obtained a licence to ply for hire in that place
